question: Can you identify the hubs that saw more than a 20% increase in finished orders from February to March?
sql:
SELECT 
    h.hub_id,
    h.hub_name,
    s.feb_count,
    s.mar_count,
    ROUND((1.0 * (s.mar_count - s.feb_count) / NULLIF(s.feb_count, 0)) * 100, 2) as pct_increase
FROM (
    SELECT 
        st.hub_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as feb_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mar_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED' 
        AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
    GROUP BY st.hub_id
) s
JOIN hubs h ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE (1.0 * (s.mar_count - s.feb_count) / NULLIF(s.feb_count, 0)) * 100 > 20
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
